correctness.rationale: PASS: Each divisor p^i q^j is a unique labelled target. A pq-divisible source can use only divisor 1; p-only uses 1,q,...,q^b; q-only uses 1,p,...,p^a; unrestricted sources use every target. The three possibilities for the source assigned to 1 are disjoint, exhaustive and contribute exactly the three falling-factorial terms. T>=2 impossible, T=1 forces unit. Positive summands yield precise Hall feasibility including both saturated corners; zero-extended factorials cover empty classes, negative integers and input zero. Independent exact gcd-mask permanents confirmed 846 four-class populations and 480/288 worked example; infinite exponent and arbitrary-X conclusion follows from bijective counting argument, not enumeration.
